problem: The nested shape is applied to every value of nltl:hasPlating, so every plating on the ship is required to have Omega >= 70 degrees and one of BI_b, M_b, or S_b. The requirement applies only to transversely-framed plating in the specified bottom hull areas, not unconditionally to all plating values.
required_change: Scope the readiness constraints to plating that is explicitly applicable under the requirement, rather than validating every nltl:hasPlating value as applicable.
regression_guard: Preserve the ship-to-plating ownership path while preventing non-applicable plating from being subjected to the I2.4.2 applicability conditions.

location: MainShape / nltl:hasPlating / nltl:framingAngleOmega / qudt:numericValue and nltl:platingHullAreaClassification sh:in
problem: COMPLEX_READINESS has no entries in directCheckSubconstraints, but the candidate executablely enforces the Omega >= 70 threshold and the BI_b/M_b/S_b controlled-value restriction. Under this verification mode, these applicability subconstraints must not be enforced unless explicitly marked DIRECT_CHECK.
required_change: Remove or make non-enforcing the Omega threshold and controlled-value checks, unless the contract explicitly marks them as DIRECT_CHECK; retain only the explicitly required readiness declarations.
regression_guard: Keep formula execution disabled and enforce only subconstraints explicitly authorized for direct checking in COMPLEX_READINESS.
